## 1. Pooled logistic robustness check

Per-problem majority outcome ~ `b0 + b1*log(B+1) + b2*log(d) + b3*log(B+1)*log(d)` (Newton MLE, Wald SEs). Positive `b1`, negative `b2`, and the implied B*(d) reproducing the binned fit support the binned estimator.

## 4. Verbosity confound at B = 16384 (amendment 7)

Think-token usage on the solvable set. If usage saturates near the cap, measured B* is bounded by verbosity, not ability (SPEC caveat).
Ablated conditions use sample_idx {0,1} only: cells run with early-stop staged sampling, so samples 2/3 exist preferentially for majority-undecided (harder) problems and would bias per-sample statistics.

| condition | n rows | mean think | median think | p90 think | frac truncated | frac > 0.9*cap |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| base (clean Pile B) | 836 | 3970 | 2324 | 9068 | 0.029 | 0.038 |
| medium | 418 | 11837 | 16384 | 16384 | 0.593 | 0.598 |
| random-s0 | 418 | 4175 | 2510 | 9816 | 0.031 | 0.048 |

## 5. Difficulty definition sensitivity (amendment 7)

Primary difficulty = median think tokens over Pile-B *successes* (fallback: over all Pile B when no success). Alternative = median over ALL Pile-B attempts (`difficulty_all_b`). Rebinning with the same edges:

- Problems changing bins: **2/396 (0.5%)** of included problems.
- Problems using the fallback definition (no Pile-B success): 1.
- Largest migrations: bin 3->bin 4: 2

| bin | n (successes-median) | n (all-B median) | bin median d (succ) | bin median d (all-B) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 49 | 49 | 840 | 840 |
| 1 | 150 | 150 | 1374 | 1374 |
| 2 | 110 | 110 | 2510 | 2510 |
| 3 | 58 | 56 | 5722 | 5722 |
